cases.assertion: A non-fast plan has at least 3 steps.
A non-fast plan has at most 8 steps.
Every step has stable id, localized title, status, and round.
Status is pending, active, done, or blocked.
Two active steps in one snapshot are rejected.
A step cannot reference a round later than the snapshot round.
plan_updated contains the complete step snapshot, current step, and round_seq.
Compaction cannot remove the fixed plan section from the brief.
Fast mode emits no plan and no plan_updated event.
Old clients ignore unknown plan fields/events and keep consuming existing events.
